translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content.text: A eb' chuc spensar sna eb' to malaj Dios. Junlajanxon̈ej ix aj sjuanel spensar eb'. Yelxo val te chuc sc'ulej eb'. Malaj mach sc'ulan vach'il.
Ato d'a satchaan̈ q'uelanemta Jehová d'a anima, yic syila' tato ay eb' syac'och spensar d'ay, yic syilpaxi tato naan yuj eb'.
A juntzan̈ b'eyb'al chuc sb'eyb'alej eb' smasanil. Junlajanxon̈ej tz'aj sjuvib'at eb'. Malaj junoc mach b'oan vach' b'eyb'al. Toton malaj val junoc mach.
Icha val to malaj spensar eb' sc'ulan chucal chi'. A eb' chi' satanel eb' yetchon̈ab', icha val to svael eb' yaj eb', max yal-laj sb'a eb' d'a Jehová.
Ste ib'xi eb' yuj xivelal, yujto a Dios ayec' yed' eb' vach' sb'eyb'al.
Snib'ej eb' syixtejb'at tas nab'il yuj eb' emnaquil, palta a Jehová scolan eb' emnaquil chi'.
Comonoc a d'a tzalan Sion scot co colnab'il a on̈ israel on̈ tic. Ayic ol yac'anxi svach'c'olal Dios d'a quib'an̈, ol tzalaj val co c'ool a on̈ yin̈til on̈ vin̈aj Jacob tic. Ol el lenaj ol quila'.
